text: is deferred action for victims of wage theft? This is a U.S. government program that protects workers from deportation for at least two years and allows these workers to receive work authorization during that time. Who is eligible for this type of deferred action? Workers who are victims, witnesses, or otherwise assist a government agency that is investigating wage theft or other labor standards violations. Who is a victim of wage theft?

speaker: SPEAKER_00
text: Workers who have not been paid all that they are owed, including overtime, breaks, minimum wage, final wages, tips, or off-the-clock work, or workers who have been the victim of unauthorized deductions or misclassification. Why is the U.S. government offering deferred action to victims of wage theft? To help workers report labor conditions without fear of deportation or retaliation from their employer. Do you want to know more about deferred action?
